title: Osteoporosis and Haemophilia
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the prevalence of osteoporosis in adult patients with haemophilia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients (≥ 18 years of age) suffering from mild (FVIII or IX \>5 %), moderate (FVIII or IX 1-5 %) or severe (FVIII or IX \<1 %) haemophilia A or B
* Submitted written consent to participate in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients suffering from other bleeding diseases
* PWH without written consent
* PWH \< 18 years of age
* Secondary osteoporosis
study_population: Adult patients (≥ 18 years of age) suffering from mild (FVIII or IX \>5 %), moderate (FVIII or IX 1-5 %) or severe (FVIII or IX \<1 %) haemophilia A or B
